dedupe_keys.name: training data to create neural networks for power system networks

description: Training data to create neural networks for power system networks is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Zewetr Aynadis. Different loading profiles for active and reactive power demands at load buses are mapped to their optimal solutions (Active power generation and voltage magnitudes at generator buses), for IEEE 14 and 30-bus standard grids solved by Matpower interior point solver (MIPS). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
